title: Ordering results for extreme claim amounts based on random number of claims
summary: Consider two sequences of heterogeneous and independent portfolios of risks $T_1,T_2,\ldots$ and $T^*_{1}, T^*_{2},\ldots$ and, let $N_1$ and $N_2$ be two positive integer-valued random variables, independent of $T_i'$ and $T^*_i$, respectively. In this article, we investigate different stochastic inequalities involving $\min\{T_1,\ldots,T_{N_1}\}$ and $\min\{T^*_1,\ldots,T^*_{N_2}\},$ and $\max\{T_1,\ldots,T_{N_1}\}$ and $\max\{T^*_1,\ldots,T^*_{N_2}\}$ in the sense of usual stochastic order and reversed hazard rate order concerning maltivariate chain majorization order.
